hubs_summary.note_scoring: hub_score = 0.40*bridge_score + 0.35*connectivity_score + 0.25*core_module_score + 20*pagerank - penalty. bridge_score rewards multi-modality bridge behavior; connectivity_score captures degree + cross-type neighbors; core_module_score uses regex keywords from section/title labels. Penalty suppresses authority sinks (high in-degree with weak bridging).
